hot.vending: Text scrolls across the vending machine: "Line of the day: Well begun is half done. ...That's only half true. The other half is starting again."
hot.poster: A study tip ad: "Close the book and try to recall it. Whatever you can't recall is what you don't know yet."
hot.sign: The station sign is blank, as if it's waiting for someone to write a name.
hot.graffiti: Someone wrote: "I decide my next stop." The ink still looks fresh.
hot.lost: Lost and found notice: "In storage: 12 umbrellas, one earbud, plenty of lost motivation. Please bring ID."
hot.tip2: An ad: "One hour on three different days beats three hours in one night. Your brain likes spacing."
hot.wall: Notes stuck to the wall: "Today flopped, tomorrow who knows", "I hate math but I'm doing it", "Getting this far is a big deal"

ep1.n1: Clunk. Your eyes open. You dozed off on the last train and rode it to the end of the line.
ep1.n3: There's a ticket in your hand. But the TO line is blank.
ep1.n4: Huh? Something is showing on the board up there.
ep1.board: Next train --:--. Destination TBD. ...Is that even a thing?
ep1.nova1: You're still here. Missed the last train?
ep1.nova2: Don't worry. I'm the station guide at this hour. Call me Nova.
ep1.c1a: I guess. I fell asleep and ended up here
ep1.nova3a: Happens to everyone. When you're tired, you ride past your stop.
ep1.nova3b: Line City. It's where the lines that only run at night all meet.
ep1.nova4: Everyone here rides their own line. But lately black shadows keep showing up on the tracks, and the trains stop dead.
ep1.nova5: And this station has no name, right? It'll stay blank until you decide.
ep1.jam1: ...mmh. Let's just go home. You did a lot today. Tomorrow's fine, isn't it?
ep1.jam2a: Right? I knew you'd get it.
ep1.jam2b: Me? I'm the one who shows up whenever you're tired. Call me Jam.
ep1.nova6a: That's Jam. Everyone has that voice. Not a bad kid, but always wants to stop.
ep1.nova6b: Yep, Jam. Everyone has that voice. Resting isn't always wrong, which is what makes it tricky.
ep1.nova7: The first train's almost here. Let's go to the other platform. You can start your line there.
ep1.nova8: Walk the tunnel on your own. Feel free to read what's on the walls.
ep1.arrive1: A light approaches in the distance. The first train. The sky is a little less black.
ep1.nova9: Here it is. This train has no fixed destination. A line appears each time you ride it.
ep1.nova10: See you at the next stop. That's where you'll see yourself for the first time. Reflected in the window.

consent.title: Okay to record your answers anonymously?
consent.l1: Your choices in the game (grade, gender, how your grades are going, survey answers) are recorded without your name. They are only used to improve the game and for research.
consent.l2: We never ask your name, student ID or contacts. What you write stays on this device, except: if you turn on the 'AI helper' at the last stop, your short talk with Nova there is sent to an AI (it isn't stored as a record).
consent.l3: You can play the same game even if you say no. Then nothing is recorded.
consent.l4: You can stop at any time.

setup.title: Passenger info
setup.name: Passenger name (pick one, not your real name)
setup.achievement: How are your grades these days, roughly?
setup.achievementHelp: Compared with your class or grade. It doesn't need to be exact.
setup.error: Please choose your grade, gender, and grade level.

survey.lead: There are no right answers. Pick what feels true right now.

thanks.title: Thanks, passenger
thanks.body: Your line has just begun. You decide the next stop.

ep2.n1: Inside the first train. You are the only passenger. The sleeping city slides past the window.
ep2.nova1: This train is a little unusual. It changes depending on who rides it.
ep2.nova2: But you haven't really seen yourself yet, have you? With that hood up, I can't tell either.
ep2.nova3: Let me ask you a few things. 24 of them. No right answers. Just pick what's closest to the everyday you.
ep2.nova4: Great, you're done. Let me show you what kind of train you are.
ep2.tunnel: Clunk. The train enters the tunnel. The window turns black.
ep2.reflect1: Someone appears in the dark glass.
ep2.nova5: {line}. That's your line color. It'll be on your ticket and your route map from now on.
ep2.nova6: Now choose how you look. It has nothing to do with the result. Just pick one you like.
ep2.nova7: Okay. A tunnel's coming up. Look at the window across from you.
ep2.nova8: At the next stop you'll choose your final station. It's okay if you don't know yet.

quiz.title: Which is most like you?
quiz.lead: Pick the one closest to the everyday you. No right answers.
quiz.tie1: Both look like you. Which is closer?
quiz.tie2: Which one are you a little bit of, too?

result.mixText: You have a bit of {name} in you, too.

avatar.title: How do you want to ride?
avatar.lead: This has nothing to do with your result. Pick a look you like. Your outfit is your line color.

ep3.n1: The train stops at a huge transfer station. Through the skylight the sky is a little brighter.
ep3.nova1: This is where you choose your final station. See the route map? The end of your line is still foggy.
ep3.nova2: Picture yourself around twenty. Done with school, becoming an adult. Who do you want to be then?
ep3.nova3: It doesn't have to be a job. No right answer. If you don't know, 'not sure yet' is fine. A foggy station is still a station.
ep3.destSet: {dest}. Nice. The end of your line just lit up.
ep3.destFog: That's okay. Let's leave it foggy. Sometimes it clears as you go.
ep3.nova4: Now let's see what you run on. Everyone's fuel is different. Pick everything that sounds like you.
ep3.fuel_interest: Fun is your fuel. Start with the fun part and you’ll go far.
ep3.fuel_growth: Getting better than yesterday is your fuel. Keep track of small wins and the tank stays full.
ep3.fuel_meaning: You move when you know why. Remind yourself of the reason often.
ep3.fuel_connection: You get energy from doing it together. Finding people to study with is a strategy too.
ep3.fuel_reward: You get energy when results show. Small, frequent rewards can work.
ep3.fuel_pressure: You can run on that fuel. But to go the distance, let's mix in other kinds too.
ep3.fuelNone: Your fuel isn't clear yet. That's okay. We'll find it together at the next stops.
ep3.nova5: One last thing. How do you think what you study now connects to that station?
ep3.nova6: Great. Now you have a final station. All that’s left is the way there.
ep3.nova7: But something always blocks the way. Let's meet it at the next stop.
ep3.destTitle: Around twenty, who do you want to be?
ep3.destOwn: My final station (stays on this device)
ep3.fuelLead: Pick everything that sounds like you. It's fine to pick none.
ep3.utilTitle: How does studying now lead to "{dest}"?
ep3.utilOwn: Write your own (optional, stays on this device)
ep3.utilOwnPh: e.g. Good English lets me meet more people
ep3.utilError: Pick at least one or write your own.
ep3.utilTitleFog: Even with the station still foggy, how might what you study now help you?
ep3.destIdeasLead: Tap one to put it in the box above. Feel free to edit it.
ep3.destEmpty: Write your station or pick an example.
ep3.destHelp: Not a job title. Write what kind of things that person does.

ep4.n1: You step out through the open door. High above the city, the eastern sky is red. The emergency light is still blinking.
ep4.n2: Something is writhing on the track in front of the train.
ep4.n3: Something black rises over the tracks.
ep4.nova1: That's the shadow that blocks the track. It looks different for everyone. Face yours and you can get around it.
ep4.nova2: Pick the cards that block you these days. At least one each from heart, thought and action, up to three each.
ep4.grow: What you picked gathers, and the shadow swells.
ep4.nova3: What would you call this thing? Once it has a name, it gets less scary.
ep4.nova4: {name}. Hear that? That isn't you. It's just something that blocks you.
ep4.nova5: The problem is {name}, not you. Seen that way, you can deal with it.
ep4.n4: CRASH! The shadow slams the track. The line snaps, and rocks come tumbling down on top of it. The shadow hides behind them.
ep4.nova6: ...The way is blocked. But it also means {name} is scared.
ep4.title: What blocks you these days?
ep4.lead: Pick at least one each from heart, thought and action, up to three each.
ep4.full: You can pick up to three per group.
ep4.freqTitle: How often does it show up?
ep4.nameTitle: What will you call this shadow?
ep4.nameLead: The card's name goes first; you choose what comes after. e.g. Anxiety + Gremlin → Anxiety Gremlin. It stays on this device.
ep4.nameError: Please write or pick a name.
ep4.t1: Inside the train on the elevated line. Dawn is breaking outside the window.
ep4.t2: The next stop should be coming up soon. But then—
ep4.t3: SCREEEECH— THUD!! The train lurches hard and stops dead.
ep4.t4: The lights flash red and an alarm starts blaring.
ep4.t5: What was that?! Something's up ahead. Let's go look!
ep4.shadow2: ...You think giving me a name changes anything? You're not getting through.
ep4.nova7: There's more than one line. At the next stop, let's find a detour around these rocks.

ep5.n1: In front of the broken track. A pile of rocks blocks the way. The sky is almost fully light.
ep5.n2: From behind the rocks, the black shadow rises again.
ep5.shadow0: You again? I told you, this way is blocked.
ep5.tut1: Time to use detour cards. Each time the shadow attacks, play one card to lay a way around.
ep5.tut2: See the colored tags on the attack card? Play a card with the same tag and it hits harder. Matches glow yellow.
ep5.tut3: The four in your hand might not have the card you want! If so, pick from 'See more cards' below. You can't lose, so take your time.
ep5.tut4: That's how it works. Each card lays one more piece of the detour.
ep5.taunts: So just give up.|It won't work anyway.|Just rest today.|You're not getting past me.|You can do it tomorrow.
ep5.hit: Perfect fit! The {tags} tag on “{card}” hit {word} right where it counts.
ep5.miss: You got around it. But against {word}, a card with the {tags} tag works better.
ep5.end1: The last tie goes down and lights blink on along the detour, one by one. A way opens past the rocks.
ep5.shadowEnd: ...Tch. So there's more than one way.
ep5.end2: See? {name} won't vanish. It'll show up again. But now you know the way around.
ep5.end3: Here are the detours you laid today.
ep5.end4: At the next stop, pick the ones you'll really use and finish your route map. Almost there. Let's go!
ep5.handLead: These cards fit this attack. Tap one to look closer and choose.
ep5.routeLead: The card you played for each shadow attack. ★ means the tags matched.
ep5.trainRun: Your train rolls out onto the lit detour, around the rocks, toward the next stop.

ep6.n1: The train stops. A familiar platform. The nameless station where you first opened your eyes.
ep6.n2: But it's different now. Morning light leaks in through the gaps in the roof.
ep6.nova1: You're back. This is where we met. Time to finish your route map.
ep6.s1: And this station. The sign is still blank, right? Now it's your turn to name it.
ep6.signLit: “{name}” The sign lights up. At that moment, the sun rises at the end of the platform.
ep6.nova3: I made two cards for you: your route map and your profile card. Save them and look at them whenever the shadow shows up.
ep6.depart: The first train sets off toward the sun.
ep6.last: Remember. You choose the next stop. Take care, passenger!
ep6.stationLead: It's where your line starts. It stays on this device.
ep6.stationIdeas: Tomorrow Station|Fresh Start|On the Way to {dest}
ep6.stationError: Please write or pick a name.
ep6.mapLead: Save both. Use them as your phone wallpaper, or print them for your desk.
ep6.saveTipIos: 📱 In the share menu, tap 'Save Image' to save it to Photos.
ep6.saveHint: Press and hold the image, then choose 'Save to Photos' or 'Save image'.
ep6.growIntro: Now let's draw your line with GROW. G goal, R where you are now, O options, W your plan. I'll help you along.
ep6.title_r: R · Reality: where am I now?
ep6.title_w2: W · Will: when the shadow shows up
ep6.tipG: You already set your goal: “{dest}.” That's the end of your line.
ep6.rQ: How far along the way to “{dest}” do you feel you are?
ep6.rShadow: {name} blocks the way sometimes. That's okay, it's part of the picture.
ep6.tipR: There's no right answer. Just pick one honestly.
ep6.tipRLow: {n}. You're at the starting line. We'll move up one step at a time.
ep6.tipRMid: {n}. You've come a fair way. Let's find where to gain one more step.
ep6.tipRHigh: {n}! You're doing well. Let's find ways to keep this pace.
ep6.oQ: To move one step closer, what would you like to change? Keep it short.
ep6.oPh: e.g. raise my math score / my phone kills my focus
ep6.oMax: You can pick up to three.
ep6.oOwn: + Use what I wrote as a method
ep6.tipO: Write what you want to change and tap 'Get ideas.' I'll find methods that fit you and your shadow.
ep6.tipONone: It's fine to leave it blank. I picked these by looking at your shadow. Choose the ones you like.
ep6.tipOFound: I see {subject}{tags} in there. These fit. Pick one to three you like.
ep6.tipOGeneral: How about these? If they don't click, tap 'More ideas.'
ep6.tipOPick: “{name}”, nice. Pick more, or move on.
ep6.wWhat: One thing to really try this week
ep6.places: at my desk|at the library|at school|at the academy|on the bus
ep6.wError: Please pick days, a time and a place.
ep6.tipW1: Small plans are easier to keep. Deciding when and where makes starting much easier.
ep6.tipW2: Last one: decide now what you'll do when {name} shows up again, so you don't have to think in the moment.
ep6.aiNote: When on, your short talk with Nova at this stop (final station, what you tried, your answers) and shadow names go to an AI (Claude), so Nova can ask and suggest ideas just for you. Don't write names, contacts or your school. The talk continues if it's off.
ep6.tipAiOn: AI helper is on. I'll make fresh ideas from what you wrote.
ep6.tipAiOff: I'll pick from the cards myself, no AI. That works well too.
ep6.tipAiThinking: Hmm... thinking about what you wrote. One moment!
ep6.tipAiDone: ✦ These are fresh ideas just for you. Pick one to three you like.
ep6.tipAiFail: The AI couldn't answer right now, so I picked from the cards myself.
ep6.tipCrisis: What you wrote worries me. Right now you matter more than any study plan.
ep6.crisisTitle: You don't have to handle this alone
ep6.crisisBody: It sounds really hard. Please tell an adult you trust (a parent, teacher or school counselor).
ep6.crisisHelp: In Korea: Youth Counseling 1388 (call 1388, text #1388), 24 hours. In an emergency call 112 or 119. Elsewhere, call your local emergency number.
ep6.coachWait: Please finish your talk with Nova.
ep6.tipRChat: Let's look at where you are now. There are no right answers.
ep6.tipOChat: Now let's find a way to move one step closer.
ep6.cR1: Have you tried anything to get closer to “{goal}”? Add what comes to mind, and mark whether each helped with 👍/👎.
ep6.triedPh: e.g. studying with my phone away
ep6.triedError: Add at least one, or tap 'I haven't tried anything yet.'
ep6.cR2good: So “{item}” helped. Trying it at all is a big deal. What was different about those times?
ep6.cR2bad: So “{item}” didn't really fit. Still, you tried, and that matters. What was hardest about it?
ep6.cR2none: That's okay, this is a fine place to start. Was there a moment when studying went a little better? When was it?
ep6.cR3: So, from 0 to 10, how far along the way to “{goal}” do you feel you are?
ep6.cR3skip: That's okay, it might not come to mind right away. So, from 0 to 10, how far along the way to “{dest}” do you feel you are?
ep6.cR4: {n}, okay. What makes it {n} and not 0?
ep6.cR4zero: You feel it's 0. Thanks for being honest. What would help it become a 1?
ep6.cR5: So here's where we are: you're at {n}, and you have “{s}” as a strength. Let's use it, one step at a time.
ep6.cR5plain: So here's where we are: you're starting from {n}. You can start from anywhere. One step at a time.
ep6.cO1: Great. To move one step from {n} toward “{goal},” what would you like to change?
ep6.cO2good: Remembering that “{item}” worked, how about these? Pick one to three that feel right.
ep6.cO2: So that's what you want to change. How about these? Pick one to three that feel right.
ep6.cO2none: That's okay, let's find it together. I picked these by looking at your shadow. Pick one to three that feel right.
ep6.cO3: “{name}”, good choice. Now let's decide when and where.
ep6.oOwn2: + Use my own words as a method
ep6.oOwnEmpty2: You can add this only after writing what you want to change.
ep6.wTimeOwn: Not here? Write your own (e.g. after practice)
ep6.wWhereOwn: Not here? Write your own (e.g. the kitchen table)
ep6.tipGChat: First, let's set the goal for this line.
ep6.cG1: Your final station was “{dest}.” That's who you want to be around twenty.
ep6.cG2: What goal would you like to reach to become that person? The closer the goal, the better.
ep6.goalPh: e.g. get over 70 in math / join a volunteer club
ep6.goalEx: Raise my math score|Build a daily study habit|Read one book on my interest|Join a related club|Keep learning English words|Focus better in class
ep6.cG3: Great, “{goal}.” Let's make it the goal of this line.
ep6.cG3same: Great, let's keep “{dest}” as the goal.
ep6.cR4good: “{item}” helped, and that's how you got to {n}. What else makes it {n} and not 0?
ep6.rChips: I kept at it|Something worked for me|I'm slowly getting better
ep6.rChipsZero: A reason to start|Someone to do it with|One small win
ep6.cO1good: Great. You have “{s}” as a strength. Using it, what would you like to change to move one step up from {n}?
